text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has scheduled time to hang
out with
Тосэн Джордан after our outing
today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So, like, what're we doing today? You
haven't
told me anything sooo... are we
winging it?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Of course not. I have a trip to an

"Umastagrammable" cafe planned for us.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Wait, are you for real?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Omigosh. This place is built for Umastagram.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Heh... I never thought you'd invite me to
a place
like this.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I mean, remember how shook you were
when I
randomly suggested we go to
karaoke for
starters?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
...What are you trying to imply? Could
you please
be more direct?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I wasn't trying to imply anything! I
was just
thinking how we gotta take a
selfie to
commemorate this event.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Is that another new Japanese custom I
have yet to
learn about?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: It sure is. It's, like, the current forerunner of trends, and right now, I feel like takin' a pic together!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
choice_data_list: I can take one for you.

text_block_list.text:
No, that's all right. You should join us.
Let's
commemorate the day together.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Click!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate you joining us today. Thank
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'd assumed an "Umastagrammable"
location was
merely photogenic, but the
cafe had a liveliness
that exceeded my
expectations. Furthermore...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: The experience was delightful.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To think I could be moved to this extent
by a
single group photo is bewildering,
to be honest.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Wait, hold up. Does this mean you've gotten used to trends enough to actually enjoy them?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
"Gotten used to?" No. If I were to put a
word to
this feeling, it would be...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"Familiar," I believe. They feel more
familiar to
me now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I still have a lot to learn, but I have
come to enjoy
discovering all of these
new experiences.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It helps that I have someone supportive
by my
side.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Aww, you guys... This is low-key kinda
emotional.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Hm? I've never heard "low-key" used in
such a
way... I've discovered yet another
term that's not
in my vocabulary.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I suspect this will happen again in the
future, so I
must find an efficient way to
learn new words.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Maybe try solely speaking Japanese for a while.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I could do that, especially since
Jordan said
she knows of forerunner
trends.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Jordan. I hope you'll take me under your
wing.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Judging by our past conversations, I
believe I can
learn all the terms and
phrases I don't know by
shadowing you
for six days.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: For real?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: A few days later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you've gotta help me out here! She
won't
leave me alone!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I have only completed 60 percent of my

objective. I shall not relent until I, too,
have
achieved trendsetter status.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's just as the hostess of the
inn
taught me—there is no need to rush.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It seems I must try to embrace the
concept of
"wabi-sabi" more fully.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Wabi what now? Is that related to
wasabi or
something?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I spy Эйсин Флэш
meditating
next to Грасс Вандер on
campus.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You're doing great. Now, let your mind
relax
further still...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You should be able to open your mind's
eye soon.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I sense it all... The wind, the soil... No,
the world...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ahhh... This feeling is sublime.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
For reals? But like, what if her mom
calls?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
My parents have their hands full with the
bakery. I
doubt I'll be receiving any
unexpected calls from
them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Flash, you're out of breath! Are
you okay?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I-it's nothing... I merely... had a call with
my
parents...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Huh? How'd a phone call wind you so
much?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
My parents are not particularly adept in

Japanese, so I communicated via
gestures using
video chat... for three
hours.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Th-three hours?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...I have learned the value of doing
everything in
moderation.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш then devotes herself to
adjusting to
life in Japan... while using
an appropriate amount
of German.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems Эйсин Флэш has not only
adjusted to
living in Japan, but on Earth
as a whole...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems Эйсин Флэш is adjusting well to
life at the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
